profile.headline: Steward of the Salesforce Marketing Cloud

positions.title: Co-founder
positions.description: ODataHQ is a mobile backend-as-a-service platform. Designed to provide developers with one platform to rapidly create all of the backend services needed to power a mobile app. The ODataHQ platform provides a data model builder, query designer, multiple forms of authentication, easy to configure roles and permissions, C# service actions, C# triggers, CDN, push notifications for iOS, Android, and Windows, user management, auto generated C# SDK, NuGet package management, API request logs, and standardized APIs via OData.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Consultant)
positions.description: Recruited to help build a marketing automation platform with hooks into the Salesforce Marketing Cloud for Cross-Channel communication to customers via Email, Web, and SMS hosted inside of Windows Azure. This system allows marketers to design and build highly targeted and relevant marketing campaigns to millions of customers, as well as, drive targeted rebuttal scripts to customer support systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Interactive Marketing Hub Team, responsible for building the ExactTarget Interactive Marketing Hub Campaign management application. Designed to allow a marketer to group and track performance of various marketing assets such as Email, SMS, Sites, Lists, and Events.

Fuel Platform Team, helped build the service layer to manage OAuth integrations to the ExactTarget Fuel API. App Center is a self-provisioned web application which allowed internal and external users the ability to manage their Fuel platform integrations.

Application Extension Framework, a generic framework for creating, staging, and publishing components which define the logic to execute, validate, publish, and save a given action. Known as custom activities, these components can be built by internal or external parties and integrated into the Interactive Marketing Hub to perform marketing intended actions.
